correctness.rationale: For each nonzero pair sum, the equation B(s,v)=Q(s) gives a line with at most two intersections on the nonzero smooth conic; the only multiply occupied unordered sum fiber is the zero sum of antipodal pairs. Orthogonality yields E=2U^2-(3/2)Σs_i^2+(1/2)Σd_i^2+|Σz_i|^2. The exact weighted variance identity decomposes (3-3/M)U^2-E as the stated three nonnegative terms. Uniform absolute value and common opposite-pair products are exactly the equality conditions. All boundary cases U=0, q=3, split/nonsplit and extension fields are covered. Direct independent finite checker corroborated in 7 odd finite fields, not used as universal proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete exact sharp extension invariant for every nonzero binary quadratic level in odd characteristic, covering both split and nonsplit forms and the natural full dual frequency space. It explains the nonisolated projective phase-torus of all maximizers and provides a nontrivial globally exact deficit quantifying three distinct stability obstructions. Such information is neither an exponent-range corollary nor a data-table recomputation, and is germane to finite-field harmonic analysis and sharp Fourier interpolation.
